commits.subject: [regexp] Share matcher case equivalence when factoring alternatives
commits.role: Makes the shortest-alternative prefix_length clamp in RationalizeConsecutiveAtoms forward-only; preserves the commit's case-equivalence refactor intent.

commits.subject: [regexp] Don't sort/factor alternatives inside lookbehinds
commits.role: Keeps SortConsecutiveAtoms disabled in lookbehinds (the commit's stated order-preservation fix) but re-enables RationalizeConsecutiveAtoms in the backward direction.

coupling:
The memory-safety defect is split across two maintenance commits that both touch the disjunction prefix-factoring pass in src/regexp/regexp-compiler-tonode.cc, and only fires when both edits are present.

RationalizeConsecutiveAtoms() factors a shared leading prefix out of a run of >=3 alternatives (ab|ac|az -> a(?:b|c|z)). Two things normally keep its per-character prefix-comparison loop in bounds: (1) the clamp `prefix_length = min(prefix_length, alt_atom->length())`, which guarantees the common-prefix length never exceeds the shortest alternative; and (2) the gating in ToNodeImpl(), which (after commit f76) disables this pass entirely inside lookbehinds (read_backward).

Commit 81ec4c2ba08 (edited): makes the shortest-length clamp apply only in the forward direction (`if (!compiler->read_backward())`). Alone this is inert -- forward factoring keeps the clamp, and the backward branch is unreachable because the lookbehind path is still gated off in ToNodeImpl, so RationalizeConsecutiveAtoms is never entered with read_backward=true.

Commit f76a45ea413 (edited): re-enables RationalizeConsecutiveAtoms inside lookbehinds (read_backward) while keeping the order-changing SortConsecutiveAtoms forward-only. Alone this is safe -- the clamp still runs unconditionally, so prefix_length stays <= the shortest alternative's length and the comparison loop reads in bounds.

Combined: a lookbehind disjunction with >=3 prefix-sharing alternatives is factored (f76) while the shortest-length clamp is skipped for the backward direction (81ec4). prefix_length retains the first (longer) alternative's length, and the per-character comparison loop (CharAtEquals -> Equals, regexp-compiler-tonode.cc:851) reads a shorter alternative's zone-allocated atom buffer past its end. AddressSanitizer reports this as a use-after-poison read of the zone redzone during regexp compilation.

pocs.trigger: RegExp compilation of /(?<=aaaaaaaa|aaaa|aaab)/ on first exec()
pocs.notes: Deterministic, no JIT/tiering required; pure interpreter path through RegExp.prototype.exec. Verified: edited tree aborts under ASan; untampered window and each single-commit edit print 'ok' and exit 0.
